benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: HDFC Bank BizPower Credit Card is a credit card option from HDFC Bank suited for business & tax users with 8 domestic lounge visits/yr.
highlights: Through this business credit card, consumers can earn 5 reward points on every Rs. 200 spent on business needs along with 5X rewards,2 on select business expenses, as shown below:
Hotel and flight bookings via MMT MyBiz (powered by HDFC Bank’s SmartBuy BizDeals)
Bill Payment via HDFC Bank’s Payzapp & SmartPay
milestone_benefits: 5X Reward Points on purchasing instant vouchers of Swiggy, Shopper’s Stop, Archies and more via SmartBuy
Amazon Prime Membership or Amazon voucher on Rs. 1,500 on 1 Tax (IT, GST) or Travel or Ads (Meta Ads, Google Ads) transactions within one month of card activation
Spend Rs. 2.5 Lakh in a quarter6 and get gift voucher worth Rs. 5,000 from MakeMyTrip or Reliance Digital
1 zero domestic flight cancellation of up to Rs. 1,200 per quarter, made via MakeMyTrip on reaching Rs. 75,000 quarterly spends
dining_benefits: 5X Reward Points on purchasing instant vouchers of Swiggy, Shopper’s Stop, Archies and more via SmartBuy
Up to 10% discount on restaurant bill payments via Swiggy Dineout
insurance_cover: Fire & burglary insurance: Up to Rs. 5 Lakh
Electronic equipment insurance: Up to Rs. 50,000
Cardholders can also get higher insurance cover by choosing an insurance plan and paying the premium
Cash in safe/transit: Up to Rs. 25,000
Hospital Cash: Up to Rs. 1,000 per day (Accident only)
Hospital Cash: Up to Rs. 1,000 per day (Illness only)

faqs.q: What are the Business Insurance Benefits of BizPower Credit Card?
faqs.a: The card comes with multiple insurance benefits including Fire & burglary insurance of Up to Rs. 5 Lakh, Cash in safe/transit of up to Rs. 25,000 and electronic equipment insurance of up to Rs. 50,000 among others. Card users can also get higher insurance cover benefits by choosing an insurance plan and paying the premium.

faqs.q: What are the travel benefits of BizPower Credit Card?
faqs.a: The card offers travel benefits with MakeMyTrip on hotel and flight bookings. Additionally, consumers can redeem the accumulated reward points for airmile conversion and flights and hotel bookings via SmartBuy.

faqs.q: Does HDFC Bank BizPower Credit Card provide lounge access?
faqs.a: Yes, the card offers complimentary domestic and international lounge access. Users get 2 complimentary domestic airport lounge visits per quarter on a min spend of Rs. 75,000 in the previous quarter. For international travel, 6 complimentary visits are offered through the Priority Pass membership.

faqs.q: What is the credit limit of HDFC Biz Power Credit Card?
faqs.a: The credit limit on HDFC Biz Power Credit Card is subjective to the consumers’ profile based on factors like income, profession, credit score, etc.

faqs.q: What are the two different loans that are offered on the HDFC Bank BizPower Credit Card?
faqs.a: The card offers Insta loan and Jumbo loan facility. The Insta loan is offered against the credit limit, whereas the Jumbo loan is offered beyond the credit limit.

faqs.q: What are the Benefits of Biz Power Credit Card?
faqs.a: HDFC BizPower Credit Card is a business card suitable for the self-employed. It offers benefits around travel, bill payments and shopping for gadgets and softwares.

faqs.q: What is the annual fee for a Biz Power credit card?
faqs.a: HDFC Bank Biz Power Credit Card comes at an annual fee of Rs. 2,500.

faqs.question: What is the annual fee for the HDFC BizPower Credit Card?
faqs.answer: The HDFC BizPower Credit Card has a joining fee and annual renewal fee of ₹2500 + GST. The renewal fee is waived on annual spends of ₹4 lakh during the card anniversary year.

faqs.question: What welcome benefits does the HDFC BizPower Credit Card offer?
faqs.answer: Complete one eligible transaction within 30 days of card issuance to choose either an Amazon Prime Annual Membership or a ₹1500 Amazon Voucher. Eligible transactions include Income Tax, GST, Google Ads, Meta Ads, flight bookings and hotel bookings.

faqs.question: How do I earn 5X Reward Points on the HDFC BizPower Credit Card?
faqs.answer: Spend at least ₹25000 on eligible non-tax transactions in a statement cycle. Once this requirement is met, eligible spends on Income Tax, GST, Google Ads, Meta Ads, PayZapp & SmartPay bill payments, MMT MyBiz bookings and business software purchases earn 25 Reward Points per ₹200. Accelerated rewards are capped at 7500 Reward Points per statement cycle.

program_updates_2026: 1 July 2026 SmartBuy Update: GyFTR & Woohoo brand vouchers carry a separate 3,000 Bonus RP/month sub-cap (~₹30k spend on Infinia, ~₹45k on DCB Metal).

Note: HDFC Bank periodically updates SmartBuy partners, reward rates and promotional offers. Always verify the latest eligible merchants and reward multipliers on the SmartBuy portal before making a high-value purchase.
